// Generated by Kaji. Verify original bytes before decoding or replay deduplication.
export class WebhookVerificationError extends Error {
  constructor() { super('Webhook verification failed'); this.name = 'WebhookVerificationError'; }
}
export interface WebhookVerificationOptions { now?: number; tolerance?: number; }
function fail(): never { throw new WebhookVerificationError(); }
function decode(value: string): Uint8Array {
  if (!/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(value)) fail();
  try { const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(value), c => c.charCodeAt(0)); if (btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)) !== value) fail(); return bytes; } catch { return fail(); }
}
/** HMAC v1 Standard Webhooks. `now`/`tolerance` are seconds; default window is 300.
 * Signatures use constant-time Web Crypto verification. Ed25519 is unsupported.
 * Persist webhook-id separately for replay deduplication. */
export async function verifyWebhook(rawBody: Uint8Array, headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, secrets: readonly string[], options: WebhookVerificationOptions = {}): Promise<unknown> {
  const body = new Uint8Array(rawBody);
  const now = options.now ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), tolerance = options.tolerance ?? 300;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(now) || now < 0 || !Number.isFinite(tolerance) || tolerance < 0 || !globalThis.crypto?.subtle) fail();
  const metadata: Record<string, string> = Object.create(null);
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headers)) { const lower = name.toLowerCase(); if (!['webhook-id','webhook-timestamp','webhook-signature'].includes(lower)) continue; if (metadata[lower] !== undefined || typeof value !== 'string') fail(); metadata[lower] = value; }
  const id = metadata['webhook-id'], timestamp = metadata['webhook-timestamp'];
  if (!id || id.includes('.') || !timestamp || !/^\d+$/.test(timestamp)) fail();
  const seconds = Number(timestamp); if (!Number.isSafeInteger(seconds) || Math.abs(now - seconds) > tolerance || !secrets.length) fail();
  const keys = secrets.map(secret => { if (!secret.startsWith('whsec_')) fail(); const key = decode(secret.slice(6)); if (key.length < 24 || key.length > 64) fail(); return key; });
  const prefix = new TextEncoder().encode(`${id}.${timestamp}.`), signed = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + body.length); signed.set(prefix); signed.set(body, prefix.length);
  let valid = false;
  try {
    for (const entry of (metadata['webhook-signature'] ?? '').split(/\s+/)) {
      if (!entry.startsWith('v1,')) continue;
      let signature: Uint8Array; try { signature = decode(entry.slice(3)); } catch { continue; } if (signature.length !== 32) continue;
      for (const key of keys) { const imported = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new Uint8Array(key).buffer, {name:'HMAC',hash:'SHA-256'}, false, ['verify']); const match = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', imported, new Uint8Array(signature).buffer, signed.buffer); valid = match || valid; }
    }
    if (!valid) fail();
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal:true}).decode(body));
  } catch { return fail(); }
}
